description: TheSportsDB team search: up to 5 teams matching a name, with sport, league, formed year, stadium, country, website and English description. Community-maintained database; uses TheSportsDB's public test key unless the owner sets THESPORTSDB_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_hockey_reference when you need NHL season standings from Hockey-Reference: every team; sports_sherdog when you need Sherdog MMA fighter profile by Sherdog fighter id: name. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
